The *Dosapariññā Sutta* (Iti 10; PTS It 5) is a discourse found in the first section of the *Itivuttaka* in the Khuddaka Nikāya. The central teaching of the text concerns the complete understanding (*pariññā*) and relinquishment of hate or aversion (*dosa*): when the mind is cleansed of passion for aversion and abandons it, one is capable of putting an end to suffering.
